name: Sophia
startScreen: I couldn't be there today, so little you is baking a giant 성심당딸기시루케이크: catch the strawberries, bake the sponges, beat me at whipping the cream, then stack it up and ice it (and deal with whatever happens next).
letter: Happy birthday, my love! I'm so bummed I can't be there with you today, so I built you a little game instead, to keep you busy until I see you next week. (And yes, I made you beat up a cake with a baguette to get here.)

27! Don't panic! We can panic together when I turn 27 in a few months (jk HAHA). But for real, I know you already know that you don't need to have your whole life figured out by now, and I know that doesn't always stop you from feeling anxious about it, especially as we head further into adulthood. And that's okay! You don't have to deal with those thoughts by yourself. Whenever you start feeling that way, keep telling me about it, even if it seems small or silly. I'll always be here to listen, talk to you, and pray together.

It's been more than three years since our little spark at the jam sessions. I know I say this often, but as time passes, it only gets more surreal looking back at how many memories we've made since then. I cherish every single one of them, every day. One of my favorites lately is our trip to Sungsimdang to try a bunch of their bread. Seeing you so happy to finally try it made me just as happy, and it's actually the memory I built this whole game around.

I'm so proud of how far we've come, even with a whole ocean between us. Being in the military without you beside me isn't easy, no matter how many months pass, even though I think I've gotten better at dealing with the solitude. So thank you for all the effort you put into spending time with me. It means more than you know. You're the first person I text the moment I get my phone back, and the last person I call before I turn it in. (But please get enough sleep too!! That's an order, and I'm in the army, so I'm allowed to give those.)

I mean it when I say thank you for coming into this world, and even more, into my life. Watching you from the side, I've seen you grow so much: in our relationship, in your faith, in your career, in your friendships, and in so much more. I can see you living out God's image in your everyday life, and it makes me want to become the best version of myself too. It isn't always easy, but growing pains are where real growth comes from, and I'm so thankful that we get to grow through them together, side by side.
I'm so glad I got to be next to you through all of 26, and I can't wait to be there for 27.

You are the most beautiful, cutest, funniest, kindest person I know: a culinary genius, a baking pro, and a certified Lagree expert. (This list has been fact-checked by me hehe.) Every day with you is my favorite day, and I can't wait to celebrate your birthday properly when I see you.
Until then, drink lots of water, eat some Haribo for me, and know that I'm thinking about you the whole time.
